# cryptoler

> Browser games, simulations, and graphics projects by Axel Jönsson, an indie developer who publishes as cryptoler.

## Projects

- [cryptoler homepage](https://www.cryptoler.net/): The project directory.
- [nibblet](https://nibblet.cryptoler.net/): cozy pixel-art fishing game
- [Noctiluca](https://boids.cryptoler.net/): An ambient boids simulation in JavaScript.
- [ingenium](https://github.com/askel-dev/ingenium): A GPU-driven forest renderer in Rust and wgpu.
- [Nobody's Meadow](https://meadow.cryptoler.net/): Survival cooking game

## Optional

- [The Eye](https://eye.cryptoler.net/): A realtime chat that closed on October 23, 2026. Its public channel is archived.
